reader.requirement: DIVIDE format 1 stores literal-1 or identifier-1's value once in a temporary and divides it into each identifier-2 in left-to-right order, each quotient replacing that dividend (a later identifier-2's subscript seeing earlier stores, per the multiple-results equivalence of VI.6.4.6).

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.UnphrasedSizeErrorIsFatal: at 85 an unphrased size error (zero divisor) is caught and the run continues; from 2002 it is fatal EC-SIZE
below 2002 the composite is the receiving items only, capped at 18 digits (EditionInfo.MaxDigits); 31 digits over all operands later (SR3, not GR1)

reader.notes: EmitDivide renders the divisor once and snapshots it whenever there are several receivers or one identified at run time, then forms each receiver's quotient as receiver / temp at that receiver's scale and ROUNDED mode, left to right, each in its own GuardedStore. VI.6.4.6 has no numbered rules, so it is named in prose only.
